# SalesMail

Welcome to SalesMail's Security Portal. Protecting customer data is foundational to how we operate. We maintain a formal security and compliance program covering access controls, encryption, continuous monitoring, vendor risk management, and employee security training, and we review and update these controls on an ongoing basis. This portal gives you visibility into our practices and a way to request our compliance documentation directly.
